name: Carol C. Menassa
title: Robert I. Carr Collegiate Professor; John L. Tishman CM Faculty Scholar
fitReason: An established host for applied embodied AI in built environments: her current group connects language/vision models to mobile robots and neural-symbolic manipulation. A CS-centered perception or planning project would fit better than a general construction-management proposal.

physicalEvidence.summary: OpenGuide uses a real TurtleBot2-based GuideBot with ZED sensing for foundation-model/POMDP object search: 48 trials across apartment and office settings. The current SICIS roster lists its student authors. March 2026 KUKAloha adds actual industrial-arm shared control; September 2026 UniPred adds collaborative learned-predicate manipulation.

KUKAloha is human coarse control plus AprilTag-based automated alignment; learned imitation-policy deployment is future work in that paper. UniPred’s newer learned components are separate.
